messages.text: I will not sign away the army's future for a promise that someone might permit it to fight. Military autonomy is my first choice. Navigation must provide dependable passage; imperial priority offers a clearer obligation than leaving every deployment at the mercy of a commercial bargain. Our troops can protect a convoy now, but protection is service with a price, not proof that the crown should command us forever.

reason: Conditioning and an intact Spear preserve our institution's practical strength. I will judge offers by the fighting they actually enable. Civilian collapse would leave us commanding a wasteland, so I want useful protection alongside military movement.
